mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gn_note_comment (id, note_id, user_id, parent_id, reply_to_user_id, content, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{noteId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{replyToUserId}, #{content}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.note_id, c.user_id, u.nickname AS author_name, c.parent_id, c.reply_to_user_id, ru.nickname AS reply_to_name, c.content, c.like_count, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.deleted FROM gn_note_comment c JOIN gn_user u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN gn_user ru ON ru.id = c.reply_to_user_id WHERE c.note_id = #{noteId} AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.created_at, c.id
